dialogueLines.line: Like, that's a really big tank you're in.
dialogueLines.speaker: shaggy

dialogueLines.line: Listen up, mutt. You're in my way.
dialogueLines.speaker: tankman

dialogueLines.line: Zoinks! I feel tiny next to you, man.
dialogueLines.speaker: shaggy

dialogueLines.line: I don't have time for talking dogs.
dialogueLines.speaker: tankman

dialogueLines.line: Like, do you ever get out of that tank?
dialogueLines.speaker: shaggy

dialogueLines.line: My tank will roll right over you.
dialogueLines.speaker: tankman

dialogueLines.line: Zoinks! Your voice booms like thunder.
dialogueLines.speaker: shaggy

dialogueLines.line: Sing fast or get crushed, mutt.
dialogueLines.speaker: tankman
